decision.rationale: TXN-007894 is a recurring charge of 67.78 EUR (6778 minor units) by Copperleaf Gym (MER-000009) on card CRD-000082. It was charged on 2026-09-19 and posted on 2026-09-20. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-29, 39 days after posting, which is within the 120-day limit in time-limits. The cardholder says they cancelled by phone but has nothing in writing, and no merchant cancellation confirmation is attached to the case. That means there is no effective cancellation date to compare with the charge date. Under recurring-no-proof, the merchant's cancellation records and subscription terms must be requested before any credit or decline.

proposed_actions.note: Please provide your cancellation records for this cardholder's membership, including any record of a phone cancellation request and its date, and the cancellation terms that applied to the 67.78 EUR charge on 2026-09-19.
